Quick question about visiting Israel on a tourist visa while in partner via process
Hi everyone!

I am currently in the process of obtaining a partner visa, and am still in the process of arranging all documents and handing in the correct ones. We already started the application and were just asked to add some documents or make changes.

My question is whether it is still possible to visit Israel on a regular tourist visa or not? I am from the Netherlands, which has visa-free access to Israel. I was hoping that while I visit on a tourist visa, I might be able to have the meeting with PIBA at that time, if possible.

I’m not sure if this is a stupid question, but for some reason I remember that it might bring issues. If anyone knows, please let me know!
